verdict.rationale: Claude Code's own docs name a 'GitHub Code Review' feature for automatic review on every PR, and also document automating code review in CI with GitHub Actions or GitLab CI/CD. Contextual grounding is only implied: CLAUDE.md can hold review checklists, and the product describes understanding the whole codebase. The evidence is a feature heading plus brief mentions, with no detail on how review comments are produced. missing for 10: detailed docs on the GitHub Code Review feature (setup, triggers, inline PR comments), evidence that feedback is contextual and specific to each PR's diff and codebase, and independent or hands-on corroboration of automatic per-PR reviews.

support.subject: As a developer, I can get automatic code review with contextual feedback on every pull request
